name: StitchedCompare
job: Compare two photos (before/after, old/new) across a divider that is a visible stitched seam you drag, with thread tension animating as you pull
visitor_action: drag the seam; arrow keys nudge; tap a side to jump
mobile: full-width, large drag handle, seam stays vertical
motion: stitches stretch and settle with spring as the seam moves (reduced-motion: seam moves with no stretch)
art_direction: Tailor's table: oatmeal linen frame with blue and white tailor's chalk marks, selvedge tapes, waxed madder-red cross-lacing, sewn-on button handle, pinned paper labels
